owner: Patrick Craven, Top Shelf Service LLC

ready_invariants.name: SingleAuthoritativeOwnerPerMutableFact
ready_invariants.assertion: Every mutable authoritative fact has exactly one owning contract/domain and exactly one permitted writer; foreign domains request change through the owner boundary.

ready_invariants.name: UnknownAuthorityFailsClosed
ready_invariants.assertion: Unknown, unavailable, ambiguous, or unregistered authority never becomes permission.
ready_invariants.failure_behavior: Deny before protected handler or side effect.

ready_invariants.name: CandidateSemanticsAreNotImplementationAuthority
ready_invariants.assertion: A candidate semantic entry cannot authorize merged implementation and cannot become approved without explicit owner approval.

ready_invariants.name: CanonicalStateClosedWorld
ready_invariants.assertion: Canonical state values and lifecycle transitions are closed sets; an unregistered state or transition is invalid.

ready_invariants.name: AmbiguousExternalEffectReconcilesBeforeRetry
ready_invariants.assertion: An ambiguous external side effect is never retried before canonical provider readback; unreadable provider state leaves the operation ambiguous.

ready_invariants.name: IdempotencyKeyPayloadBinding
ready_invariants.assertion: The same idempotency key with the same payload yields the same final state/response; the same key with a different payload is rejected.
ready_invariants.failure_behavior: Reject mismatched reuse with zero side effect.

ready_invariants.name: RetryDoesNotDuplicateAuthoritativeEffects
ready_invariants.assertion: Retry or concurrent replay cannot create duplicate authoritative effects.

ready_invariants.name: AtomicMultiWriteOutcome
ready_invariants.assertion: Operations required to succeed together commit atomically; no partial result is observable.

ready_invariants.name: TenantBoundaryIsAuthoritative
ready_invariants.assertion: Protected reads and writes cannot cross authoritative organization/location scope.

ready_invariants.name: MembershipScopeUsesDatabaseCurrentState
ready_invariants.assertion: Membership/scope authority is resolved from current authoritative records on each protected request; inactive/revoked membership confers no scope.

ready_invariants.name: ClientInputCannotCreateAuthority
ready_invariants.assertion: Client-supplied IDs, headers, path/query/body values, frontend state, and JWT claims cannot establish tenant, target, or authorization authority.

ready_invariants.name: ProtectedOperationsDefaultDeny
ready_invariants.assertion: Every protected operation is registered exactly once to one capability; absence from the registry is denial.

ready_invariants.name: EntitlementCannotCreateCapability
ready_invariants.assertion: Entitlement may restrict capability effect but cannot create a capability and is read-only to authorization.
ready_invariants.failure_behavior: Deny unauthorized effect; reject authorization-owned entitlement mutation.

ready_invariants.name: DeniedProtectedMutationHasNoSideEffect
ready_invariants.assertion: A denied protected mutation produces no state change or external side effect except explicitly permitted audit.

ready_invariants.name: PublishedContentVersionIsImmutable
ready_invariants.assertion: Only valid content can be published/assigned; a published content identity+version never changes in place.
ready_invariants.failure_behavior: Reject invalid or in-place mutation; require new version.

ready_invariants.name: ContentExistenceDoesNotGrantAccess
ready_invariants.assertion: Content existence or possession of a content ID does not grant access; assignment and authorization are independent required facts.

ready_invariants.name: LearningSessionMutationRequiresActiveState
ready_invariants.assertion: Learning progress events are accepted only in ACTIVE sessions; COMPLETED is terminal.

ready_invariants.name: LearningProgressIsServerAuthoritative
ready_invariants.assertion: Real learning progress derives from persisted canonical learner events/state with content identity/version; client-only values cannot be authoritative progress.
ready_invariants.failure_behavior: Do not record/display client-only progress as real.

ready_invariants.name: CertificationIssuanceIsCompleteAtomicAndIdempotent
ready_invariants.assertion: Certification issuance requires all currently defined mandatory authority/binding facts, commits with audit atomically, and cannot duplicate under replay.
ready_invariants.failure_behavior: Reject issuance or rollback; never persist a partial/duplicate certification.
notes: Criteria-version and evidence-shape details remain separately blocked; this invariant does not claim those undecided values.

ready_invariants.name: EvidenceNonPassStatesNeverPass
ready_invariants.assertion: UNKNOWN, BLOCKED, CONTRADICTORY, skipped, missing, stale, or unreadable required evidence cannot become PASS.

ready_invariants.name: EvidenceIsBoundToExactCandidate
ready_invariants.assertion: Evidence proves only the exact source SHA/environment it records; CI alone never proves production conformance.
ready_invariants.failure_behavior: Reject mismatched or CI-only production claim.

ready_invariants.name: OffboardingIsTotalAndIdempotent
ready_invariants.assertion: Offboarding uses one lifecycle path, ends IdentityStatus INACTIVE, revokes effective sessions/credentials/tokens/membership/grants, emits one lifecycle/audit outcome, and replay does not duplicate effects.
ready_invariants.failure_behavior: Atomic rollback or same final offboarded outcome.

blocked_invariants.name: DeletionAndAnonymizationInvariant
blocked_invariants.reason: Deleted/anonymized/retained meanings, retention periods, and exemptions are not owner-approved.

blocked_invariants.name: ConcreteRoleCapabilityClosure
blocked_invariants.reason: The invariant shape is known, but the concrete capability vocabulary and role bundles are not approved.

blocked_invariants.name: LearningDerivedMetricDeterminism
blocked_invariants.reason: Mastery/XP/streak/rank derivation rules are not approved.

blocked_invariants.name: CertificationCriteriaAndEvidenceCompleteness
blocked_invariants.reason: Criteria/checklist version and observed-performance evidence semantics are not approved.

blocked_invariants.name: ContentSchemaVersionPolicy
blocked_invariants.reason: Content schema must be versioned, but the approved schema-version policy/value is not yet decided.
